texts.zh:
我们最具生产力的克隆设施之一因一起事故而突然停产，造成重大损失。

由于我们的许多操作都为了效率而自动化，在关键时刻没有人能够及时介入处理这次事故。

一个刚下生产线的克隆人滑倒，卷入机械装置中被碾碎，导致生产线堵塞，不得不完全停产。
texts.en:
Clone production at one of our most productive facilities has been halted suddenly due to an incident which caused significant damage.

As many of our operations are automated for efficiency, there was nobody to intervene at a key moment which led to the disturbance.

Fresh off the conveyor belt, one of the clones slipped and found themself caught in the mechanisms, grinding them up, causing a pile up, and necessitating a full stop on production.

label.en: Resume production as quickly as possible!
